items.t: Polk County K9 Ace’s handler gets replacement after line-of-duty shooting: Meet K9 Vader
items.x: The Polk County Sheriff's Office added 15-month-old German Shepherd K9 Vader to its active roster alongside Handler Natalie Oestreich, following the forced retirement of her former K9, Ace.

items.t: 'He'll always be a part of this': Organizer remembers son ahead of fundraiser for accessible aquatic center
items.x: Dozens of paddlers are taking to Lake Shipp this Saturday in Winter Haven to help make sure people of all abilities can enjoy spending time in the water.

items.t: Company donates new K-9 to Polk County Sheriff's Office deputy after hearing K-9 Ace's story
items.x: A deputy with the Polk County Sheriff's Office has a new K-9 partner after her previous partner was forced to retire.

items.t: Lakeland man who shot, killed horse in 2024 gets 1 year in state prison
items.x: Joel Gutierrez was also placed on the animal abuse registry, according to the Hillsborough County state attorney.

items.t: Armed citizens pull gun on knife-wielding intoxicated woman at Florida Dollar General: PCSO
items.x: A knife-wielding Kissimmee woman who is in the country illegally was arrested after threatening customers with a knife and being held at gunpoint by armed citizens at a Polk County Dollar General, according to the sheriff's office.

items.t: South Florida Avenue Reconstruction Expected to Take More Than 3 Years
items.x: Lakeland’s $26.3 million project will bring wider sidewalks, improved crossings and a permanent three-lane design to Dixieland.

items.t: More Voting Myths, Debunked
items.x: Early voting begins Oct. 19, in Polk County. In part three of our series demystifying and debunking myths and misinformation about Florida elections, we're tackling the truth about vote by mail and polling places.

items.t: LPD Hosts National Prescription Drug Take Back Day Saturday
items.x: From 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. on Oct. 24, the Lakeland Police Department will host a drive-through drop-off for unwanted, unneeded, or expired medication.

items.t: Registration for LPD’s Cops for Kids Begins Oct. 26 and 27
items.x: The program has provided Christmas gifts and nurtured positive relationships with thousands of Lakeland children since it began in 2007.

items.t: Polk Disables Public Comments on County-Run Social Media Accounts
items.x: On Tuesday, Oct. 20, Polk County commissioners reached a unanimous vote to disable comments on all 21 county-run social media accounts, a decision that county officials say will curb misinformation and cut down on vulgarity.

items.t: More Than Candy: Why Lakeland Churches Go Big on Fall Festivals
items.x: From sensory-friendly activities to massive trunk-or-treats, Lakeland churches offer family fun while building community connections.

items.t: 35th Annual Red Ribbon Run Coming Saturday, Oct. 31
items.x: The 35 annual Red Ribbon Run, promoting healthy, substance-free living, returns to Lake Mirror this Saturday, Oct. 31.

items.t: Polk Supervisor of Elections Debunks Social Media Ballot Rumors
items.x: LkldNow asks Melony Bell about social media claims that ballots might be rejected if written on by poll workers.

items.t: FL Poly Police Launch Aircraft Designed for Rescue Ops and Student Learning
items.x: On Tuesday, Oct. 20, the Florida Polytechnic University Police Department unveiled what it described as the first police aircraft of its kind in the country.

items.t: Lowe’s Insourcing of Plant City Warehouse Impacts 178 Saddle Creek Jobs
items.x: Lowe’s plans to bring Plant City warehouse operations in-house, ending Saddle Creek’s role and putting 178 positions in transition.

items.t: 10-year-old Oregon girl kidnapped from home in middle of the night, then found alive, tied up in closet
items.x: A girl was found safe after police said a man entered her family's apartment, attacked her sister and abducted her early Wednesday morning.

items.t: Cornell faculty to move forward with no-confidence vote over handling of sexual assault allegations
items.x: Cornell University faculty will move forward with a vote on a no-confidence measure over its handling of sexual assault allegations.

items.t: James Fishback says he made a 'terrible mistake' by accusing Byron Donalds of being under federal investigation
items.x: Fishback previously accused Donalds, as well as U.S. Rep. Cory Mills, of being under a sex trafficking investigation. The DOJ had said those claims were false.

items.t: Hillsborough County Fire Rescue opens new fire station in Palm River
items.x: Hillsborough County Fire Rescue celebrated the opening of Fire Station 15 on Wednesday, which will serve the Palm River area.

items.t: Nearly 75% of NFL players who died between 2008 and 2023 had CTE, study finds
items.x: A Boston University study found 74.5% of NFL players who died between 2008 and 2023 had CTE, a brain disease only diagnosable after death.
